integration_points: ExecutionEngineAdapter implements ITradeExecutor protocol using PessimisticExecutionEngine
ComplianceEngine can use pessimistic execution for realistic order fills
Adapter provides realistic slippage (5 bps default) and t+1 execution simulation
All 5 ITradeExecutor methods implemented: execute_order, cancel_order, modify_order, get_order_status, get_open_orders
